run_local_gpu_experiment: run a local GPU experiment using XManager with a Docker container and CIFAR10 entrypoint
create_experiment_local: create an XManager local experiment with a custom experiment title and GPU requirements
package_python_container: package a Python container with a base TensorFlow GPU image and module entrypoint for local execution
configure_docker_options: configure Docker options for interactive or non-interactive local container execution
launch_job_with_executor: launch an XManager job with a local executor that tracks output and requires 2 GPUs
